scalars.scalar_value: Minimum one year experience as an EKG Technician conducting a standard three channel 12 lead EKG, two and three channel holter monitor test, three channel holter scanning, treadmill exercise test.

items.item_text: Minimum one year experience as an EKG Technician conducting a standard three channel 12 lead EKG, two and three channel holter monitor test, three channel holter scanning, treadmill exercise test.
Dual Isotope nuclear stress test, pharmacologic stress testing and tilt table testing experience
Minimum one year experience in cardiovascular or electrocardiology transcription using a transcribing machine

Demonstrates adherence to the Standards of Conduct Requirements. Completes and turns in the SOC acknowledgement card.Fulfills compliance education requirements as directed by the Compliance Department or Department Manager.
Meets the requirements in all necessary systems including centralized scheduling and hospital information systems computer.
Meets annual competency requirements prior to evaluation date, including incorporating defined age specific requirements as applicable.
Receives physician's written request for electrocardiographic procedures and generates order per departmental procedure.

Is responsible for performing electrocardiographic procedures with consideration on various age range like newborn (neonates), pediatrics, adolescents, adults, geriatrics and females of child bearing age. Is responsible for performing electrocardiographic procedures and coping with consideration on patients of all ethnic, socioeconomic, cultural and educational backgrounds.
Ensures proper patient identification before performing prescribed procedure.
